limitation: Exploratory follow-up on four already observed development months, not new confirmatory OOS evidence. Only the fixed estimation window changes. Fixed alpha does not imply identical per-sample regularization; scaling, sample size and estimation variance also change. No drift trigger, online update, recalibration, market download, final-holdout access, orders or trading-performance claims. Month-start model readiness is logical; measured fit time is not simulated execution latency.

feature_formulas.return_std_5m: sample std(ddof=1) of last 5 one-minute log returns, ending at t
feature_formulas.return_std_15m: sample std(ddof=1) of last 15 one-minute log returns, ending at t
feature_formulas.return_std_60m: sample std(ddof=1) of last 60 one-minute log returns, ending at t
feature_formulas.volume_change_1m: volume[t] / volume[t-1] - 1; prior volume must be positive
feature_formulas.volume_zscore_60m: (volume[t] - mean(volume[t-60:t])) / sample_std(volume[t-60:t]); excludes current bar from reference
feature_formulas.taker_buy_volume_ratio: taker_buy_base_asset_volume[t] / volume[t]; volume must be positive
feature_formulas.trades_change_60m: number_of_trades[t] / mean(number_of_trades[t-60:t]) - 1; excludes current bar from reference
feature_formulas.close_range_position: (close[t] - low[t]) / (high[t] - low[t]); range must be positive
